payload.instance: uuid — the battlemap instance whose open combat is reordered, when the command names no target
payload.order: array of uuids — every participant of the open combat, once each, named by its token (or its initiative entry), in the order the DM gives: the first gets rank 1, the next 2, and so on, without gap. An order that omits or repeats a participant, or names one that is not in the combat, is refused. A hidden participant takes the rank it is given (hidden-keeps-rank); no participant is added or removed and the turn does not move
